# @canopy/policy

Document Level Security: the policy DSL, stored format, compiler, field rules, explain, lint and the policy test runner.

Policies are code, one collection per file, compiled into a MongoDB filter for reads and writes and a matcher for change events.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/policy
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { allow, auth, collection } from "@canopy/policy"

export default collection("todos", {
  exposed: true,
  realtime: true,
  policies: [
    allow.read("authenticated").where({ ownerId: auth("sub") }),
    allow.insert("authenticated").check({ ownerId: auth("sub") }),
  ],
  fields: { read: { default: { omit: ["internalNotes"] } } },
})
```
